interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to complete the pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Install bollards or a concrete curb to separate the bike lane from motor traffic, providing a buffer for the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to allow safe crossing.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting fixtures designed for the sidewalk to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at the side street intersection to reduce crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install standardized curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalks on both sides of the street.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or lane narrowing treatments to reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or physical barrier between the roadway and the new sidewalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Greening
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer or a row of street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with appropriate signage and lighting to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion

interventions.title: Street Trees

interventions.title: Vegetated Buffer Strip
